family_reports.body: I have lost time with my kids and have been legally bullied.

I lost precious years with my children, my successful business, and my reputation while fighting a system that too often rewards conflict and turns children into leverage. No parent should have to watch their children weaponized while being financially and emotionally destroyed just to remain in their lives.

This has destroyed us. The one thing the kids could count on is that no matter what I was there. And now I just watch more and more as they become the little girls that I've become due to the constant mental and emotional warfare that they are subjected to daily. As a cop's daughter and somebody that used to believe in the law, I have absolutely no faith whatsoever that any of the system is anything but broken.

The Brazos County court system has left my family deeply fractured after I was ordered with only 24 hours’ notice to relocate my four children to the same town as their father, forcing immediate school changes, housing decisions, and major financial disruption. I was told the alternative was incarceration and that my children would be placed in their father’s sole custody. This has had a lasting impact on my family’s stability and well-being.
